title: They’re Young and Frustrated and Want France to Change. They Disagree on How.
summary_full: One is a left-wing student leader, the other a young far-right activist. Together, Soumaya Sarré and Louise Montangon reflect the polarization of France, where more protests and strikes took place on Tuesday.
